mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'UNPAID' AND order_type = 'DINE_IN') AS open_tables, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dining_tables WHERE status = 'WAITING_PAYMENT') AS waiting_tables, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employees WHERE status = 'ACTIVE') AS active_employees, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_requests WHERE status = 'PENDING') AS pending_requests

SELECT pay.id AS payment_id, o.id AS order_id, o.order_type AS order_type, CASE WHEN o.order_type = 'TAKEAWAY' THEN CONCAT('Mang về #', o.pickup_code) ELSE t.name END AS table_name, pay.paid_at AS paid_at, pay.amount AS amount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.amount), 0) FROM refunds r WHERE r.payment_id = pay.id) AS refunded, pay.method AS method, e.full_name AS cashier_name, CASE WHEN pay.proof_image_path IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS has_proof FROM payments pay JOIN orders o ON o.id = pay.order_id JOIN counter_shifts s ON s.id = pay.counter_shift_id JOIN employees e ON e.id = s.employee_id LEFT JOIN dining_tables t ON t.id = o.table_id WHERE pay.status = 'COMPLETED' AND pay.paid_at >= #{from} AND pay.paid_at < #{until} ORDER BY pay.paid_at DESC, pay.id DESC

SELECT o.id AS order_id, t.id AS table_id, t.name AS table_name, t.status AS table_status, o.created_at AS created_at, SUM(CASE WHEN oi.status NOT IN ('CART', 'CANCELLED') THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price ELSE CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(13,2)) END) AS total_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN oi.status NOT IN ('CART', 'CANCELLED') THEN oi.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS sent_count, SUM(CASE WHEN oi.status = 'SERVED' THEN oi.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS served_count, SUM(CASE WHEN oi.status = 'CART' THEN oi.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS cart_count FROM orders o JOIN dining_tables t ON t.id = o.table_id LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'UNPAID' AND o.order_type = 'DINE_IN' AND t.status = 'WAITING_PAYMENT' GROUP BY o.id, t.id, t.name, t.status, o.created_at ORDER BY o.created_at, o.id
SELECT id, full_name, username, role, status FROM employees ORDER BY role, full_name, id
